_meta.indication: Monotherapy for treatment of patients with deleterious BRCA mutation (germline and/or somatic) associated advanced ovarian cancer who have been treated with two or more chemotherapies; select patients based on an FDA-approved companion diagnostic

pivotal_trials.design: Two-part, phase 2, open-label, single-arm, multi-center trial
pivotal_trials.population: Women with relapsed high-grade epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer after prior platinum-containing chemotherapy
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Primary: PFS (INV) and ORR (INV) by RECIST v1.1
pivotal_trials.result: ARIEL2 contributed 64 patients (24 in Part 1 and 40 in Part 2) to the pooled 106-patient BRCAm efficacy population (with 42 patients from Study 10 Part 2A). In that pooled population, investigator-assessed ORR was 54% (95% CI: 44, 64) with median DOR 9.2 months (95% CI 6.6, 11.6).

nct_ctgov.title: A Study of Rucaparib in Patients With Platinum-Sensitive, Relapsed, High-Grade Epithelial Ovarian, Fallopian Tube, or Primary Peritoneal Cancer (ARIEL2)

pivotal_trials.design: Phase 1/2, open-label, single-arm study of oral rucaparib
pivotal_trials.population: Patients with gBRCA mutation ovarian cancer or other solid tumor
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Primary: Safety, MTD, PK, ORR by RECIST v1.1; Key secondary: OS
pivotal_trials.result: Contributed to the pooled efficacy population of 106 BRCAm patients supporting the ORR of 54% (95% CI: 44, 64)

nct_ctgov.title: A Study of Oral Rucaparib in Patients With a Solid Tumor (Phase I) or With gBRCA Mutation Ovarian Cancer (Phase II)

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (>=20%) were nausea, fatigue (including asthenia), vomiting, anemia, abdominal pain, dysgeusia, constipation, decreased appetite, diarrhea, thrombocytopenia, and dyspnea. Most serious concern: MDS/AML occurred in 2 of 377 (0.5%) patients, including one fatal event of AML.
target_moa: Rucaparib is an inhibitor of poly (ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP) enzymes, including PARP-1, PARP-2, and PARP-3, which play a role in DNA repair
companion_dx_detail: FoundationFocus CDx BRCA test, an NGS-based companion diagnostic detecting BRCA1 and BRCA2 alterations (germline and somatic) in tumor tissue

advisory_committee.vote: The Division did not obtain the advice of the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee (ODAC) for this NDA as there were no safety or efficacy issues identified that required outside advice

description.text: Added new indication for maintenance treatment of adult patients with recurrent epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer in complete or partial response to platinum-based chemotherapy, and converted accelerated approval to regular approval for BRCA-mutated treatment indication

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for a new indication for the maintenance treatment of adult patients with recurrent epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer who are in a complete or partial response to platinum-based chemotherapy. Furthermore, this supplemental application provides for regular approval for the treatment of patients with deleterious *BRCA* mutation-associated epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer who have been treated with two or more chemotherapies, which was granted accelerated approval under 21 CFR 314 Subpart H on December 19, 2016.

description.text: Added accelerated approval for BRCA-mutated metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer after AR-directed therapy and taxane chemotherapy

citations.quote: This "Prior Approval" supplemental new drug application provides for a new indication for Rubraca (rucaparib) for the treatment of adult patients with a deleterious *BRCA* mutation (germline and/or somatic)-associated metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer who have been treated with androgen receptor-directed therapy and a taxane-based chemotherapy.

description.text: Updated Dosage and Administration section based on analytical and clinical validation studies supporting a cf/ctDNA companion diagnostic; no new indication added

citations.quote: This Prior Approval Supplemental new drug application provides for revisions to the Rubraca U.S. Prescribing Information, including an update to the Dosage and Administration section, based on analytical and clinical validation studies, as outlined in PMC 3833-2 from the May 15, 2020, approval letter.

description.text: Converted accelerated approval to full approval by fulfilling PMR 3833-1 confirmatory study for mCRPC

citations.quote: We approved this NDA under the regulations at 21 CFR 314 Subpart H for accelerated approval of new drugs for serious or life-threatening illnesses. Approval of this supplement fulfills your commitments made under 21 CFR 314.510.

surrogate_endpoint.text: Objective response rate (ORR) and duration of response

citations.quote: *This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on objective response rate and duration of response. Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in confirmatory trials.*

confirmatory_requirement.text: Confirmatory trials ARIEL3 (CO-338-014) and ARIEL4 (CO-338-043) required to verify clinical benefit

citations.quote: Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in confirmatory trials (ARIEL3 and ARIEL4).

orphan_indication.text: Rucaparib had orphan designation status, which exempted the applicant from PREA requirements

citations.quote: Rucaparib has not been studied in a pediatric population. The orphan designation status exempted the applicant from PREA Requirements.

summary.text: Rucaparib received accelerated approval under 21 CFR 314.500/314.510 (Subpart H) based on ORR and duration of response, with a priority-reviewed NDA; the drug held orphan designation, and continued approval is contingent upon confirmatory trials ARIEL3 and ARIEL4.

citations.quote: The recommendation for the accelerated approval of rucaparib, according to 21 Code of Federal Regulations (CFR) 314.510 Subpart H, is primarily based on efficacy data from 106 patients with deleterious BRCA mutation associated advanced ovarian cancer who have been treated with two or more chemotherapies, and safety data from 377 ovarian cancer patients, treated on two open-label, single arm trials
Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in confirmatory trials (ARIEL3 and ARIEL4).
